system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: the task-dispatcher will instruct the context-loader to compose the task-specific context with few-shot examples and CoT instructions as the prefix context for the visual reasoning planner
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; task-specific few-shot prefix per task type. Could be read as dynamically_composed.

env_context_strategy.note: Visual input is passed to modules; no repo/environment context mechanism in harness sense. Paper only; no code available.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config surface. Video frame sampling is input preprocessing, not history compaction.

observation_format.note: Planner LLM does not observe tool results; the plan is generated once. Paper only.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The planning script consists of a sequence of declarative program instructions, each is expressed as an assignment statement with output variable, per-instruction-specific visual reasoning module with module name and input parameters.
tool_call_format.note: The model writes a VisProg-style program script that is parsed and executed.

tool_count.note: The module count is shown in Figure 3 only, and the figure text is not in the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: Not a file-editing system; paper only, no tool registry available.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The task repos-itory stores not only the ICL examples and CoT instructions, but also the backend neurosymbolic modules
tool_schema_source.note: Modules are presented to the model through hand-written few-shot examples.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no dependencies or source code to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It transforms the planning script into executable code based on visual input (image or video) and the combination of neural models and symbolic func-tions and then performs a sequence of actions
loop_primitives.note: Two-stage plan then execute through a fixed parser, executor and verifier pipeline.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: generates a structured visual rea-soning plan (symbolic program script) for each compositional visual reasoning task

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The first stage is managed by a front-end engine that generates a structured visual rea-soning plan
multi_agent_topology.note: Single LLM planner; the auxiliary LLM calls are verifiers, not agents.

delegation_mechanism.note: Paper only; no agent factory available.

human_in_loop.note: Paper mentions a visualizer for human-in-the-loop debugging, but no gating mechanism is described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The planning script consists of a sequence of declarative program instructions, each is expressed as an assignment statement with output variable
short_term_state.note: State is inferred to be the program variables (BOX0, IMAGE0, ...).

long_term_memory.note: The task repository holds static few-shot examples, which do not count as memory.

self_verification.evidence_quote: including type-checking of all external and internal modules w.r.t. module names, module input parameter types and output variable names
self_verification.note: The caption verifier uses a separate LLM such as GPT-3.5 to judge output consistency (Sec. 2.2); the ensemble verifier is also present.

retry_policy.note: Script repair and chunk resampling capped at t iterations are not whole-task retries.

termination_condition.note: Termination is inferred to be at program end (the RESULT instruction), but this is not stated as a harness condition.

cost_controls.note: Ensemble pruning reduces model calls, but it is not a listed cost control.

tracing.evidence_quote: Our code and runtime logs are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VLAgent.
tracing.note: Log format is unknown; an execution visualizer also exists.

eval_hooks.note: The task repository lists benchmarks (GQA, VQAv2, and others), but the repo was not available to confirm an evaluation runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The Script Repair module is triggered to fix errors and generate the correct planning script.
guardrails.note: The SS-Parser validates and repairs the program before execution.

target_domain.evidence_quote: a Vision-Language Agent system for efficient compositional visual reasoning

open_source.note: An anonymous code link is given, but no licence is visible.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The LLM is either by default or chosen by the user of VLAgent in her configuration.
model_agnostic.note: The paper evaluates GPT-3.5, Llama, Mistral and GLM.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
primary_artifact.note: Coded from the paper only; the repository was not in the evidence.

pinned_version.note: The paper mentions only an 'alpha version'; there is no commit.

stars.note: No GitHub repo URL is available.
